purpose: Extend the headless DXF 3D consumer probe with selected REVOLVEDSURFACE and SWEPTSURFACE callback-field and opaque-payload identity checks.
changes: Added runtime-authored AC1027 REVOLVEDSURFACE and SWEPTSURFACE records with distinct fields and transforms.
Asserted REVOLVEDSURFACE axis point/vector, angle, transform, draft, twist, and solid/close-to-axis fields under ext=false and ext=true.

Asserted SWEPTSURFACE modeler/isolines, sweep/path IDs and payload sizes, four distinct matrix slots, draft/scale/align fields, alignment/Boolean controls, and reference vector under ext=false and ext=true.
Verified exact size, SHA-256 digest, and preserved disposition for both SWEPTSURFACE group-310 payload chunks in the neutral consumer carrier ledger.
Excluded nonzero DWG classVersion and group-71 pathFlags from DXF roundtrip expectations: the official Autodesk SWEPTSURFACE DXF table does not list either field. Their mapping remains unqualified.
scopeLimit: Generated same-library DXF callback and carrier-identity evidence only. It does not qualify surface evaluation, independent interoperability, DWG field layouts, or native consumers.
fixturePolicy: DXF files and payloads are generated from source literals at runtime and removed; no drawing fixture file was added.
claimEffect: No support claim changes. The S8.3 consumer probe now checks selected REVOLVEDSURFACE/SWEPTSURFACE data and tracks the two swept payload carriers separately from typed fields.
